name: Contentful MCP
description:
## About the Contentful Remote MCP App

The Remote MCP App makes your Contentful spaces accessible to AI agents, enabling them to perform content management operations. Once installed, the app gives space admins a simple dashboard to control exactly which Contentful tools are available to AI clients, like enabling read-only access for marketing teams auditing content, or unlocking write tools for developers building agentic workflows. Each space gets its own configuration.

## Features

### Per-Space MCP Permissions

Configure which tools are exposed to AI clients on an environment-by-environment basis, scoping access to only what each team or workflow needs.

### Granular Tool Control

Toggle individual tools on or off — restrict to read-only content queries, or enable write operations for agentic content pipelines.

### Admin Dashboard

A simple, purpose-built UI for space administrators to review and update tool permissions without touching code.

## Requirements

This app must be installed in a Contentful environment before the Remote MCP server can be used within that environment.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Contentful MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Contentful MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.contentful.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Contentful MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contentful MCP lists 70 MCP tools, including append_entry_field, archive_asset, archive_entry, create_ai_action, create_concept, create_concept_scheme, create_content_type, create_entry, create_environment, create_locale, create_tag, and create_upload_session.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Contentful MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Contentful MCP in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Contentful MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contentful MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Contentful MCP is developed by Contentful Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
